scope: All five original New game concepts and the active Marshal's Orders production background
revision_scope: A non-destructive revised Marshal's Orders background; original concepts and active game asset retained
historical_direction: Predominantly Prussian, Napoleonic campaign setting circa 1813–1815; simplified pixel-art heraldry, not an exact regiment reconstruction

observations.assessment: Tactical-map imagery is broadly European. The central eagle's silhouette suggests two heads; it should be replaced by a clearly single-headed Prussian eagle before use. Miniature troop uniforms cannot be assigned confidently at this scale.
Pale eagle flag suggests Prussian intent, but the eagle and shako plates are generic. Cross-belts, tall shakos, smoke and decorative crosses alone do not identify nationality.
German place labels reinforce the intended setting but do not prove uniform accuracy. Maps, compasses and troop arrows are neutral. Eagle silhouettes require the same single-head consistency check.

Paired portraits expose ambiguous generated hat badges, elaborate plume/cockade details and inconsistent miniature eagles. The right shako badge is not clear enough to call it French or Prussian. This is the selected scene to revise.

White eagle banners provide a Prussian cue, but the tiny eagles and generic shako decorations remain ambiguous. Artillery, cavalry and cross-belts are period military scenery shared by multiple armies.

revision_requirements: One clearly single-headed crowned Prussian eagle in the central ornament and a consistent simplified eagle on the flags
Plain campaign bicorne on the general; no ambiguous leafy badge, giant plume or invented awards
Simpler dark infantry shako, brass trim and black/ivory cockade; remove stacked diamond and leaf/grenade ornaments
Simple spearhead flagpole finials rather than French imperial eagle sculptures
Remove the plume and ambiguous rosette on the lower still-life hat
Retain the existing ivory/charcoal/ochre/gold/slate palette and flat #BBBBAA background

references.supports: Prussian 1813–1815 regiment history, period uniform variation, and crowned Prussian eagle with sword on 1815 flags
DHM Prussian shako, probably 1813–1836, black leather/wool/felt and brass chinscales
Earlier Prussian infantry eagle flag with sword and thunderbolts; general heraldic reference, not a claimed exact 1815 regimental flag
